name: Youchou to Hentai Gumo
source:
Haruna, who can not afford the latest popular game is thrilled when she spots a web survey that promises the game as a reward to those who fill it out. However, that web survey has been created by lolita loving Katayama as a trap to ensnare girls just like Haruna!!

What is the fate of the young butterfly who becomes the prisoner of this hentai spider?!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047953.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
榛名买不起最新流行的游戏，当她发现一项网络调查时，她很兴奋，该调查承诺将游戏作为对填写调查问卷的人的奖励。然而，那个网络调查是由喜欢洛丽塔的片山创建的，作为诱捕像春菜这样的女孩的陷阱！

成为这只无尽蜘蛛的囚徒的小蝴蝶的命运是什么？！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047953.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
